description: Ten-row staff upsert matched by personnel number; existing staff move to another city with new weekly hours, new staff carry role, personnel number, hours and one qualification without e-mail. In upsert mode validation also looks up each row's existing record (skipStaffRoleGrantCheck). Upsert mix: rows with an even index exist and change fixed cells, rows with an odd index are new, so the file and every 100-row chunk are half new and half existing. Measured by TestStaffImportBatchQueryBudget after two warmups (ADR 0067 addendum 2026-11-08, Messplan N10/N110).
